title: Holly River State Park Electrical Restoration
overview: Storm damage knocked out power across the 8,101-acre park. Phase 1 restored emergency supply to key areas, going from design to bid in under four weeks ahead of winter. The team then buried 2.5 miles of supply cabling in conduit, replaced ~8,000 ft of 15kV cable, swapped pit-mounted transformers for pad-mounted units, and added RV pedestals in the campground.
